components.name: Neutral Action Button
components.description: The default outlined action for dispatch and ordinary controls.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--sans); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 96, 'wght' 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.015em; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms linear, color 120ms linear, transform 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; border-style: dashed; }

components.html: Read-state model
components.css: .ds-mode { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-mode label { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1 1 50%; } .ds-mode label + label span { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-major); } .ds-mode input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode span { width: 100%; font-family: var(--sans); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 88, 'wght' 600; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem; color: var(--ink-2); transition: background 140ms linear, color 140ms linear; } .ds-mode input:checked + span { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-mode input:focus-visible + span { box-shadow: inset var(--focus); } .ds-mode label:hover input:not(:checked) + span { background: var(--paper-deep); } .ds-vh { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Unread Event Mark
components.description: A solid participant-owned event with an explicit unread word and raised tick.
components.css: .ds-event { --ds-channel: var(--ch-a); position: relative; width: 3.6rem; min-height: 2.4rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--ds-channel); border-radius: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; padding: 0.2rem 0.1rem; } .ds-event-unread { background: var(--ds-channel); color: var(--paper); } .ds-event-tick { position: absolute; top: -0.55rem; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 0.5rem; background: var(--ds-channel); transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-event-id { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-variation-settings: 'wght' 400; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-event-state { font-family: var(--sans); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 84, 'wght' 700; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Read Event Mark
components.description: A hollow participant-owned event struck through to encode read state without hue alone.
components.css: .ds-event { --ds-channel: var(--ch-b); position: relative; width: 3.6rem; min-height: 2.4rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--ds-channel); border-radius: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; padding: 0.2rem 0.1rem; background: var(--paper); } .ds-event-read::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -0.3rem; right: -0.3rem; top: 50%; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--ds-channel); } .ds-event-tick { position: absolute; top: -0.55rem; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 0.5rem; background: var(--ds-channel); transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-event-id { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-variation-settings: 'wght' 500; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-event-state { font-family: var(--sans); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 84, 'wght' 700; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ds-channel); }

components.name: Evidence Stamp
components.description: A compact outlined status stamp whose color follows the computed evidence state.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--sans); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 86, 'wght' 720; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.28rem 0.6rem; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; } .ds-stamp-pending { color: var(--alert); } .ds-stamp-pass { color: var(--ch-c); } .ds-stamp-fail { color: var(--ch-a); }

narrative.northStar: The Trace: a printed channel record
narrative.overview:
The explainer is a warm, exacting instrument record rather than a terminal costume. A ruled channel field owns the mechanism; editorial serif text owns the argument. Thin rules, event ticks, rail marks, condensed captions, and explicit state words make routing and read state inspectable without turning the page into a dashboard.

The visual density is deliberate but orderly. Chart-stock surfaces and saturated channel inks keep the mechanism legible, while long passages retain a comfortable editorial measure. Every built mark has a job: location, attribution, state, boundary, or evidence. At documentation time (2026-09-16, before acceptance), every receipt row was pending. Live acceptance status belongs solely to `assets/receipts.js`; this design record does not imply an installed or working runtime.
keyCharacteristics: Warm printed stock with dark record ink and fine functional rulings.
One channel grammar at three scales: working field, inline glyph, and section mark.
Editorial Newsreader prose paired with condensed Archivo captions and narrowly scoped JetBrains Mono data.
State communicated by fill, strike, border pattern, words, and hue together.
Flat, exposed structure with no decorative shadows or ornamental cards.

rules.name: The Redundant State Rule
rules.body: Hue identifies a participant; unread, read, self, gone, and held are also distinguished by fill, strike, border treatment, and words.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Ochre describes pending or constrained states; it is not a success color. Moss is the built passing state, and vermilion is the built failing state.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif explains, condensed sans labels, and mono identifies machine data; do not let mono become the page's atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Separate levels with stock tone and rulings; do not lift panels with decorative shadows.

dos: Do preserve redundant state encoding: words and marks must remain meaningful without hue or motion.
Do keep acceptance language derived from `assets/receipts.js`, and leave a row pending until a real observed check supplies evidence.
Do retain full-size event marks on narrow fields and reduce visible slots instead of shrinking the marks.
Do use the participant inks for attribution and action ownership, not as the only signal of read state.
Do keep every rule, tick, and gap tied to information or navigation.
donts: Don't claim installation, runtime acceptance, or passing evidence while the receipt rows remain pending.
Don't turn the printed record into a terminal theme or spread monospace beyond ids, paths, commands, and evidence.
Don't introduce decorative shadows, rounded cards, texture, or uninformative rules.
Don't infer the mechanism from animation alone; every state transition also needs visible words.
Don't collapse participant, lineage, and address into one visual or conceptual unit.
